subject: CloudForge -> Redwood: demo slots & integration snippets
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina@cloudforge.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Interest after signup — integration questions + demo?

Hi Sergio,

We just tried Redwood via the self-serve flow and are excited about potential integration with OpenRepo. A few quick questions before we schedule a demo:

- Does Redwood support repository-level webhook filtering (e.g., only push + PR events)?
- For installs that come from org-owned apps, do you support short-lived deploy keys or do we need to provision a bot user?
- Any sample code for the webhook payload -> Redwood ingestion?

We're a small infra team (CloudForge). Ideally we'd get a 30–45 minute walkthrough focused on: 1) quick demo of the GitHub connector, 2) webhook security model, and 3) sample code for event-to-embedding flow.

Available this week (PDT): Tue after 3pm, Wed morning, Thu anytime. Could you include our engineering lead Sam (sam@openrepo.io) on the invite?

Thanks — Lina

Lina Torres
Head of Integrations, CloudForge
lina@cloudforge.ai
https://cloudforge.ai
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Lina Torres <lina@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interest after signup — integration questions + demo?

Hi Lina — great to hear you spun up a trial, welcome!

Short answers up front:
- Yes, our connector supports repo-level filters; you can pick events by repo and event type.
- We recommend org-installed app + short-lived app tokens for security; bot users are supported but not required.
- I'll attach a small snippet and a one-page agenda for the demo.

I'd love to book a 30-minute slot that focuses on the three items you listed. My Calendly is below, or I can propose times:
- Wed 09/15 09:30–10:00 PDT
- Wed 09/15 11:00–11:30 PDT
- Thu 09/16 14:00–14:30 PDT

If none of those work, tell me a couple of windows and I'll loop Marissa (she's our AE for platform integrations) to coordinate. We'll include Sam on the invite.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-sergio/30min

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
SDR, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai

Attachments: integration-snippets.txt (3KB), demo-agenda-cloudforge.pdf (12KB)
From: Lina Torres <lina@cloudforge.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@openrepo.io>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interest after signup — integration questions + demo?

Thanks, Sergio — the Wed 09:30 slot works for us. I've added Sam to the thread.

Quick additional items to cover if possible:
- Example of payload size limits and any tokenization/embedding recommendations for large diffs
- Where audit logs for webhook deliveries are surfaced in Redwood Console

Looking forward to the demo — see you Wed 9:30 PDT.

— Lina

Quick heads-up — I need to swap the Wed 9:30 slot to 11:00 due to a calendar conflict on our side. Apologies for the short notice. Proposed new slot: Wed 09/15 11:00–11:30 PDT.

If that doesn't work for you both, we can keep the original and I will have Marissa run the session.

I've attached a short security Qs doc (security-questions.docx) that our Security PM often sends to customers; it might help Sam prep.

Thanks for the flexibility — Sergio

From: Sam Patel <sam@openrepo.io>

Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interest after signup — integration questions + demo?

Hi Sergio, Lina — 11:00 PDT tomorrow works for me.

I'll review the attached security doc ahead of time. A couple notes for the demo agenda:
- Please show the webhook retry/backoff settings and where we can surface failed deliveries (we ingest events into our pipeline and will want to alert on failures).
- If possible, include a tiny live snippet showing the event -> embedding step; we use Go for our ingest pipeline.

See you at 11:00 PDT. Invites and calendar link?

— Sam Patel
Lead Engineer, OpenRepo
sam@openrepo.io
